tags.title: The Smoochy Song
tags.lyrics-eng:
I’m going to play the first part of the song

I’m looking for a red thread

I’m looking for a red thread

I’m looking for a red thread
I was dreaming
I hate you
I hate you I hate you
Because you don’t know anything about me
I hate you I hate you I hate you
No matter how much we talk,
you don’t know anything about me
I know you can’t act, but I want you to laugh I can’t live without you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you I love you
I love you

I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you
I love you I love you
I love you I love you I love you
I love you

I love you

Kowai, kowai, kowai wa datte Watashi anata no nani mo shiranai Kowai, kowai,
kowai wa

Mitorete ita no yo Nani mo wakaranakutatte Ii wa,
ii wa Iku yo Aishiteru,
aishiteru, aishiteru,
aishiteru Chu, chu, aishiteru,
aishiteru, aishiteru

Aishiteru, aishiteru,
aishiteru, aishiteru Chu,
chu, aishiteru, aishiteru,
aishiteru Chu, chu

Aishiteru, chu
